    Rays and ray transversals #

    Definition 3.2 and Corollary 3.3 (projective-rays.tex). For 0 ≠ f ∈ A(x, y), U(f) = R_x f R_y is uniserial with radical R(f), its unique maximal subbimodule (le_endpointRadical), and "[f] = U(f) ∖ R(f)" (eq:ray-layer; here mem_ray_iff). Corollary 3.3: "In each corner, the chosen vectors represent the consecutive one-dimensional quotients of a finite chain. They therefore form a basis adapted to every member of that chain."
